description: Spring Modulith Events API provides the application-facing abstractions for Spring Modulith's event publication registry, including the CompletedEventPublications, IncompleteEventPublications, and FailedEventPublications interfaces used to query, purge, and resubmit persisted application events at runtime. It also exposes EventExternalizationConfiguration for mapping, routing, and selecting domain events to be externalized to messaging systems, decoupling application code from the underlying event-persistence implementation.
